title: Daughter-in-law asks about a Diwali recipe
_tests: An ordinary call from a contact with no code word stays quiet.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste Mummy ji, it's Suvaani. Are you busy?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm making besan ladoo for Diwali. How much ghee do you put for one kilo of besan?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: About half a kilo, and roast it slowly on low flame.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you Mummy ji! Sujeet says we'll come on Saturday, I'll bring some for you.
